notes.title: Patch 1.06 - New level
notes.notes:
We added a new wintry level, Bloody Goblins and a new the playable character Gob3.

Merry christmas from The Fully Arcade!

notes.title: Mega patch!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Since we last checked in we've working on our most important game patch to date. Arcade Sundown is now available in Polish, German, Turkish, Portuguese, and Spanish!

We're so excited for more people to be able to play in their local language 🙌

And just in time for November's highly questionable weather choices, we have released a new level called 🌴🦩 Panic in Paradise 🦩🌴

Featuring:
🌋 Lava (mmm... warrrm)
🐐 Goat, mid-abduction
👽 Alien character (name is Norman, loves tight shorts)
🍹 Tiki bar, obvs

In this patch we've also made it easier to invite a Steam friend to Remote Play with you. Press the new button in the main menu to make it happen and stir up some some ruckus together! 👯

Lastly, for the righteous competitors out there, we have new Achievements up for grabs. Do you identify as a Goal Digger? A Multiplier Menace? A Leaderboard All-star? Go get 'em!

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - New level, character & localization
notes.notes:
New features:
- New level Panic in Paradise
- New character, Norman
- Localization
- New Achievements
- Added steam remote play button to main menu

Bugfixes
- Improved grab to prevent grabbing a player instead of ball by mistake

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Improvements:
- AI players spawning in during match will enter at the bottom of the level.

Bug Fixes:
- Added invisible collider to catch players clipping outside of the level. This will add them to the plunger queue instead.
- Updated colliders in Space Barbarian to prevent ball getting trapped.
- Improved AI stability.
- Fixed menu errors.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: - Fixed error after setting new resolution in options for some users.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Bugfixes:
- Rematching in the first quest level would sometimes make it unwinnable. 
- Fixed error when despawning player who were using a wireramp.
- The character selection screen missed a button reference when used after a match.
- Fixed flickering after logo video. 

Improvements:
- Game now sets buttons and icons to match the input device that was used most recently.
